article.headline: Cleveland State defeats Alabama A&M 74-73 in OT
article.description: — Alex Bruskotter scored 17 points as Cleveland State beat Alabama A&M 74-73 in overtime on Sunday.
article.linkText: Cleveland State defeats Alabama A&M 74-73 in OT

categories.description: Cleveland State Vikings @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs

event.description: Cleveland State Vikings @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs

keywords: Cleveland State Vikings @ Alabama A&M Bulldogs
article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. -- — Alex Bruskotter scored 17 points as Cleveland State beat Alabama A&M 74-73 in overtime on Sunday. Bruskotter had four steals for the Vikings (3-2). Obie Bronston Jr. finished 4 of 9 from 3-point range and 3 for 3 from the line to add 15 points. Curtis Stinson Jr. finished 5 of 13 from the field to finish with 12 points. Kevin Paul Jr. led the way for the Bulldogs (3-2) with 16 points and seven rebounds. Alabama A&M also got 15 points from James Graham. Sami Pissis finished with 12 points and three steals. Up next Cleveland State plays Tuesday against Xavier on the road. Alabama A&M hosts Lipscomb on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
